dct_title_s: Eastern Archipelago. : Plans in Sumbawa and Flores
dct_description_sm: From Netherlands Government surveys between 1904 and 1910 ; Published Oct., 1913, at the Hydrographic Office, under the authority of the Secretary of the Navy.
Depths shown by soundings, relief by form lines and spot heights.
Soundings in fathoms, heights in feet.
Shows depths, low water, reefs, coastal vegetation, towns, peaks.
Chart 1. Sumbawa - East Coast: Tanjong Wamba to Toro Rano -- Chart 2. Flores - West Coast: Molo Narrows -- Chart 3. Flores - West Coast: Labuan Bajo -- Chart 4. Flores - North Coast: Telok Terang.
